business_summary: Nuveen Select Tax-Free Income Portfolio is a closed-ended fixed income mutual fund launched by Nuveen Investments Inc. The fund is co-managed by Nuveen Fund Advisors LLC and Nuveen Asset Management, LLC. It invests in the fixed income markets of United States. The fund invests in the investment-grade municipal securities rated Baa and BBB or better. It benchmarks the performance of its portfolio against the Standard & Poor's (S&P) National Municipal Bond Index and Lipper General and Insured Unleveraged Municipal Debt Funds Average. Nuveen Select Tax-Free Income Portfolio was formed on March 19, 1992 and is domiciled in the United States.
business_summary_ko: Nuveen Select Tax-Free Income Portfolio는 Nuveen Investments Inc.가 출시한 폐쇄형 고정 수입 뮤추얼 펀드입니다. 이 펀드는 Nuveen Fund Advisors LLC와 Nuveen Asset Management, LLC가 공동 관리합니다. 미국 채권시장에 투자합니다. 이 펀드는 Baa 및 BBB 이상의 등급을 받은 투자등급 지방채에 투자합니다. S&P(Standard & Poor's) 전국 지방채 지수와 Lipper General 및 Insured Unleveraged Municipal Debt Funds Average를 기준으로 포트폴리오 성과를 벤치마킹합니다. Nuveen Select Tax-Free Income Portfolio는 1992년 3월 19일에 설립되었으며 미국에 주소를 두고 있습니다.
